name: Silk Cursor Trail
description: A smooth cursor trail effect for React: a glowing ribbon that follows the pointer like a silk thread, bends through every turn, tapers from head to tail and gathers back when the pointer rests. Canvas 2D, no dependencies.

props.name: length
props.description: Points in the trail. More points = a longer tail.

props.name: headWidth
props.description: Stroke width at the head, in px.

props.name: tailWidth
props.description: Stroke width at the tail, in px.

props.name: headColor
props.description: Colour at the head (any CSS colour). The glow uses it too.

props.name: tailColor
props.description: Colour at the tail. Use a transparent colour to fade the tail out.

props.name: smoothing
props.description: How loosely the trail follows, from 0.1 (tight) to 1 (slow and silky).

props.name: glow
props.description: Soft glow around the trail, in px. 0 = none.

props.name: fixed
props.description: Cover the whole viewport. false keeps it inside the parent (give the parent position: relative).

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the canvas, e.g. a different z-index.
